notes:
• Subtitle search: Audio & Subtitles › Search subtitles… finds subtitles on OpenSubtitles in your languages, with ones made for your exact file first. Pick one and it comes on without restarting
• New setting Auto-fetch subtitles (off by default): downloads subtitles when the file has none in the language you want
• Optional OpenSubtitles sign-in in Settings for more downloads a day
• Audio: plays the file's default or first track instead of the highest bitrate one, still in your audio language (fixes silent audio on some soundbars)
• Backing out in the first 1% no longer sends anything to your watch service
